[Review Number 482] I highlight all the good / bad stuff I've found in Nivalis Nights after playing it for several hours and give my opinion throughout... How does the game compare to similar shop management and store simulator games like Ale & Tale Tavern, or Supermarket Management Simulator? Is it worth buying or playing for $25?

You can support the channel at http://patreon.com/LFP or https://streamelements.com/lfpgaming/tip and you can also buy Steam games DIRECTLY from developers at https://www.nexus.gg/lfpgaming

PC Specs: Nvidia RTX 5080 GPU with AMD Ryzen 5 5700X3D CPU and 64GB DDR4 RAM

0:00 Verdict

Steam description: "Grow your business, manage restaurants and nightclubs, make friends and enemies, buy and decorate apartments, go fishing and maybe even find love in a cyberpunk city that stretches from the ocean to the clouds."
